notes:
REF-BM-02: Metadata fetches title, description, and favicon, but no preview image.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but notes are unsupported.
REF-BM-06: Saving an existing URL creates a duplicate without guiding the user to edit.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain comma-separated input with no autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, domain, and tags, but not notes or the complete URL.
REF-BM-14: #tag syntax is not parsed and does not match stored tags.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised expressions are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are not parsed as exact matches.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action interface.
REF-BM-21: No action can be applied to the full currently filtered collection.
REF-BM-22: The list merely claims recent ordering; no selectable sort key or sorting implementation exists.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and markdown rendering are absent.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshot preservation is absent.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is absent.
REF-BM-26: Bookmarks cannot be archived.
REF-BM-27: No reversible archive operation exists to distinguish from deletion.
REF-BM-28: There is no archived-bookmarks view.
REF-BM-29: Saved dynamic filter bundles are absent.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: There is no personal display-settings facility.
